page.overview:
Who is Liiria Beldonna?

Liiria Beldonna was the female Human leader of an organization of mercenaries also referred to as "Beldonna's Legion."

Liiria Beldonna was a Corellian woman born sometime around 25 BBY.

By roughly 1 ABY, she had built up an organization of hired mercenaries referred to as "Beldonna's League" or "Beldonna's Legion." Elements of the group were stationed on Corellia and Talus. Beldonna led the Legion under a strict set of rules and did not tolerate misconduct; her men were fiercely loyal to her.

Around 3 ABY, the group was hired by Imperial Consul-General Gilad Halsek of Kothlis, who was infatuated with Beldonna, to help bolster the planet's security. Beldonna enjoyed her position on Kothlis and frequently took her team hunting in the forest or the planet's ice caps.
